map.闭管基频计算器，输入管长与声速，按一端闭口管基频 f₁=v/4L 求驻波基频，用: The closed pipe fundamental calculator takes the pipe length and speed of sound and uses the closed-end fundamental f1 = v/4L to get the standing wave fundamental, for wind instruments and acoustic resonance analysis.
map.一端闭口、一端开口的管，基频波长为管长 4 倍。: For a pipe closed at one end and open at the other, the fundamental wavelength is four times the pipe length.
map.一端闭一端开的管（如闭管乐器、瓶口）驻波频率 f_n=n·c/(4L)，n=1,: For a pipe closed at one end and open at the other (such as a closed-end wind instrument or a bottle mouth), the standing wave frequencies are f_n = n*c/(4L), n = 1, 3, 5, ...
map.计算闭管基频与奇次泛音。: Compute the closed-pipe fundamental and odd harmonics.
map.管风琴或教学演示中预测发声频率。: Predict the sounding frequency in organ tuning or teaching demonstrations.
map.：管长 L=0.34 m、声速 c=343 m/s，基频 f1=c/(4L)=3: Pipe length L = 0.34 m and speed of sound c = 343 m/s give the fundamental f1 = c/(4L) = 343/1.36 = about 252 Hz; only odd harmonics are allowed (3f1, 5f1, ...).

map.为什么闭管只有奇次谐波？: Why does a closed pipe have only odd harmonics?
map.闭端必为声压波腹、开端为波节，边界条件只允许 n 取奇数，故缺失偶次泛音。: The closed end must be a pressure antinode and the open end a node, so the boundary condition only allows odd n, and the even harmonics are missing.
map.和开管有何不同？: How does it differ from an open pipe?
map.开管两端皆波节，f_n=n·c/(2L) 含全部整数谐波，基频比同长闭管高一倍。: An open pipe has a pressure antinode at both ends, so f_n = n*c/(2L) includes all integer harmonics, and its fundamental is one octave above that of a closed pipe of the same length.
